english.note: Use this in everyday speech when “various” means simply different, especially before 嘅 + noun.

exampleSentences.english: There are various restaurants here; it depends what you want to eat.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢度有唔同嘅餐廳，睇下你想食乜。
